# Causal Delivery Diagnostics

Routine observation family under #2151/#2542 and existing private fixture
raw_sql_policy. Delivery's existing read_projections owner provides the original
recursive causal-tree delivery groups, non-runtime-log run delivery/claim totals
and ordered attempt diagnostics. Existing private selected-read adapter and
public detached bridges retain exact original coordinator ownership; no raw
getter, arbitrary query/callback, reconstructed owner or eligibility policy.

The fixed-query oracle compares each full original SQL literal after whitespace
normalization. Root and every descendant remain in the exact run, UNION retains
cycle/duplicate termination, delivery run equality stays, complete class/id/
status/COALESCE-reason grouping and order remain. Totals preserve COUNT and SUM
of claim_version, exact event-run filter and runtime-log exclusion. Attempt rows
retain every version and closure, NULL/default raw text, exact delivery identity
and version order. Late read/scan/iterator/close errors discard all evidence.
Failure diagnostics never supply runtime correctness or replace public proof.

Three independent complete consumer-shape oracles pin original time contexts,
non-resetting diagnostic deadline, integer widths, native owner/run/event/id,
all five group fields and every attempt diagnostic field. Negative controls
reject wrong owner, scope, errors, reason/count mapping, deadline and data loss.
The outer S03 workload, public correctness assertions, original targets/ceilings,
poll spacing and phase/transaction-report formatting are unchanged.

with its opt-in transaction diagnostics enabled. No exhaustive sibling matrix.

It runs without h.db, requires three exact read commits/zero writes/no active
